srcActionId.description: Source action id that invalidated the entry to return entries for.

entryType.description: Value of entryType field to return values for.

status.description: Status value to return values for.

context.description: Context value to return values for.

contextFields.description: Filter values for individual context fields when the context value type is an included type.

errorCode.description: Error code to return values for.  Only valid for finding/reporting errors

nodePool.description: Node pool to return values for.

rescheduleKey.description: Key for rescheduleByType operation to return values for.

nullFields.description: Fields to search for null values on.

customFilter.description: Custom filter expression following normal conventions for {@link FetchSpec#filter}.

include.description: Fields to include in the returned instances.  Follows same rules as {@link FetchSpec#include}.

offset.description: Index of first entry to return.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return.  Specifying -1 will return all

title: Used for specifying filter criteria for count/find functions.  All conditions will be "AND"ed.  Any that are null will be ignored.
name: InvalidationQueue.FindSpec
